decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is distant from the core and only mentioned on the website, so its value is still highly uncertain, but niche defence and maritime contracts are long-cycle and cheap to keep listed, so the option stays open until procurement results arrive.
The medical examination light builds on existing competences, has its own page and costs little to maintain, and one year of evidence is too early to judge its value.
The explosion-proof industrial luminaire line fits the core industrial customer base, carries sunk certification investments and has strong prospects, so it warrants continued commitment.
The relaunched designer task light is close to the established offer and builds on an already popular product, so its value is relatively proven and the cost of keeping it is low.
